provenance.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Dino Atlas vertical mobile gallery color-pattern and head-feather detail candidate, anatomy-review only
Input image: Image 1 is the project-owned approved Velociraptor mongoliensis skull, facial identity, and plumage reference only. Preserve its species identity and feather material, but create a genuinely new close portrait; do not mirror, recolor, or reuse its full-body lateral standing composition.
Primary request: A calm living Velociraptor mongoliensis head, neck, and upper shoulder portrait in cool Djadochta dawn light, designed specifically as a non-representative S2 color-and-feather detail rather than a full-body anatomy image.
Composition/framing: vertical 4:5 portrait, tight front-left three-quarter view. The complete long low skull and closed toothed snout run diagonally from lower-right toward upper-left, with the full snout tip, jawline, eye, back of skull, neck, and upper shoulder all in frame. Intentionally end the crop at the upper shoulder before either forelimb and well before the hips; no hand, foot, leg, tail, or partial limb may enter the frame. Leave soft open dune haze around the head. This is a deliberate head-and-plumage study, not a cropped full-body scene.
Identity lock: one head only; long low toothed snout about sixty percent of skull length, narrow non-bird jaw, many small teeth visible only along the closed lip margin, restrained brow, one natural eye on the visible side. No modern bird beak, owl face, round parrot head, giant eagle eye, horn, crest, ear pinna, duplicate jaw, extra eye, or tyrannosaur proportions. Short dense body feathers cover the neck and shoulder; fine facial scales remain around the snout and eye. Preserve a plausible dromaeosaur skull-to-neck transition.
Color/pattern: cool blue-slate crown and neck, dusty celadon-gray cheek and throat, restrained aubergine shoulder patch, copper-rust around the eye and rear jaw, sparse pale irregular pinspots. The marks must vary in size and spacing with natural asymmetry, no perfect rows, rings, zebra bars, or palette-only copy.
Scene/style: softly blurred pale gravel fan and distant warm dunes at dawn; highly detailed natural-history museum paleoart, realistic living animal, original project-owned visual, no named-artist or franchise style. No other animal, prey, attack, blood, text, watermark, logo, jewelry, harness, modern object, partial limb, footprint pattern, or full-body claim.
